from.place: Step 3: the Tag 012K filtered-complex cycle and boundary calculation

title: Cycles and boundaries for a filtered complex
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], let $K^\bullet$ be a cochain complex, and let $F^\bullet K^\bullet$ be a bounded decreasing filtration by subcomplexes [def-sp-filtration]. For every $p,q,r$ with $r\ge1$, define subobjects of $\operatorname{gr}^pK^{p+q}$ by $Z_r^{p,q}=((F^pK^{p+q}\cap d^{-1}(F^{p+r}K^{p+q+1}))+F^{p+1}K^{p+q})/F^{p+1}K^{p+q}$ and $B_r^{p,q}=((F^pK^{p+q}\cap d(F^{p-r+1}K^{p+q-1}))+F^{p+1}K^{p+q})/F^{p+1}K^{p+q}$. Then $B_r\subseteq Z_r$ and the filtered-complex spectral sequence has $E_r^{p,q}\cong Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$. Equivalently, writing $X^{[a,b]}=F^aK^\bullet/F^bK^\bullet$, the same object is naturally isomorphic to the image of $H^{p+q}(X^{[p,p+r]})\to H^{p+q}(X^{[p-r+1,p+1]})$ induced by the map $F^pK^\bullet/F^{p+r}K^\bullet\to F^{p-r+1}K^\bullet/F^{p+1}K^\bullet$. For $r=1$, $Z_1$ is the cycles of $\operatorname{gr}^pK$ and $B_1$ is its boundaries, so $E_1=H(\operatorname{gr}^pK)$; for sufficiently large $r$ the terms stabilize. This is the filtered-complex description of Stacks Tag 012K.
